scenes.title: Trinity University student alone at a microphone and silver tap-bell ringing >6 times in 5 minutes while trying NOT to think of a white bear
scenes.era: 1987, Trinity University psychology booth, San Antonio, Texas

layout.description: Clean brightly lit 1987 individual recording room with plain cream walls, a wooden desk holding a silver tap-bell, a desktop stand microphone, a printed instruction card reading 'DO NOT THINK OF A WHITE BEAR — Ring Bell If It Occurs', and a white porcelain polar-bear figurine sitting outside in the experimenter's control window.

positions.who: Student Participant (mannequin in 1987 collegiate polo shirt and jeans)
positions.where: seated alone at the wooden desk pressing a palm down onto the silver tap-bell AGAIN with an exasperated head-shake while glancing desperately around the bare room walls

positions.who: Daniel Wegner (mannequin in 1987 Oxford shirt and glasses)
positions.where: standing outside the observation glass holding a tally counter showing a steep Period-2 Rebound spike (16+ rings)

props.name: chrome tabletop tap-bell
props.period_detail: classic silver call bell centered beside the desk microphone
props.physical_behavior: tapped >6 times during initial suppression and >16 times during the Period-2 rebound surge

props.name: 'DO NOT THINK OF A WHITE BEAR' instruction placard
props.period_detail: crisp black-on-white 1987 printed card propped on the desk
props.physical_behavior: every glance at the card re-primes the forbidden bear

props.name: Period-1 vs Period-2 Rebound bar chart
props.period_detail: researcher's clipboard chart showing Suppression-First Period 2 towering above Expression-First

actions.verb_sequence: reads 'DO NOT THINK OF A WHITE BEAR' -> stares hard at the desk lamp and shoe trying to distract himself -> freezes and taps the silver bell AGAIN -> sighs and taps it a seventh time
flips the Period-2 sign to 'Express Freely' and watches bell taps surge past 16

reactions.reaction: laughs in disbelief at how fast 'Don't' summoned the exact forbidden thought
notes how scanning random room objects turned the lamp and wall into bear triggers

scenes.wardrobe: 1987 Texas collegiate wear: pastel cotton polo shirt, pleated jeans; researcher in crisp striped Oxford button-down and slacks.
scenes.recognition_hook: Seated alone with a microphone and a silver bell, students ordered NOT to picture a white bear ring the confession bell every forty-five seconds — then rebound forty percent higher afterward.

key_visual.description: a 1987 college student at a wooden booth desk tapping a silver desk bell beside a stand microphone and a 'DO NOT THINK OF A WHITE BEAR' card

scenes.title: Young Tolstoy standing in the 1863 nursery corner

layout.description: Sunlit 19th-century wooden study corner where a young boy mannequin stands facing two wainscot walls while his older brother grins behind him.

positions.where: standing in the sunlit corner covering face in comic defeat

props.name: carved white porcelain bear figurine on shelf
props.period_detail: visual emblem of the older brother's impossible club rule

actions.verb_sequence: whispers the dare -> Young boy stands in corner unable to clear his mind

reactions.reaction: turns around laughing after five helpless minutes

scenes.recognition_hook: Wait in this corner until you stop thinking of a white bear — Tolstoy's 1863 childhood dare became modern cognitive science.

scenes.title: Experiment 2 Cure: The Single 'Red Volkswagen' Anchor

layout.description: Same booth desk, now holding a crisp card reading 'If a white bear occurs, focus on ONE Red Volkswagen beetle' beside a small red die-cast model.

positions.where: speaking calmly into the microphone with right hand resting relaxed BESIDE the silent silver bell

props.name: Red Volkswagen replacement card & silent bell

actions.verb_sequence: anchors smoothly on the single replacement image -> Period 2 bell count stays completely flat with zero rebound

reactions.reaction: circles the flat Experiment-2 rebound bar

scenes.recognition_hook: Giving the brain ONE absorbing positive destination wiped out the white-bear rebound in Experiment 2.

scenes.title: Golfer / Speaker swapping 'Don't hit water' for 'Land center green'

layout.description: Bright sunlit golf green bordering a pond where a player crosses out 'Don't hit pond' in a yardage notebook and points club squarely at a crisp white center flagstick.

positions.where: aligning shoulders calmly toward the center pin and rolling the ball dead-center

props.name: positive target yardage card ('Aim Center Pin')
props.period_detail: replaces ironic hazard monitor with clear motor target

actions.verb_sequence: locks eyes on center pin -> strokes smooth putt straight to the cup

scenes.recognition_hook: Your brain steers toward whatever noun you feed it — feed it the target, never the hazard.
